hc_sha_gate.what_it_hashes: final HC state as BF16 bits after the 43-layer BOS graph

alu_is_idle.consequence: Unlike Q80, a codec that spends more reconstruction work is affordable on DSV4F IF it cuts bytes. Rank candidates by bytes first, reconstruction cost second.

routed_fp4_plus_scale.how: 43 layers x top-6 of 256 x 3 proj x 2048x4096 native 16-level FP4

shared_fp8_plus_scale.how: 43 layers x 1 shared x 3 proj x 2048x4096 FP8

manifest_census.note: routed_all_256 is STORAGE of every expert. ACTIVE billed as top-6/256 of that mass because every expert has the same stored bytes (verified by routed_experts_uniform).

requant_probe.note: CPU source-algorithm preview. Breaks hc_sha by construction. ALU cost of the extra decode is affordable (DSV4F ALU 0.77% idle).

candidates.name: C0_current_native
candidates.mechanism: no change; native FP8 MLA / FP4 routed / FP8 shared / BF16 head+router
candidates.numeric_contract: bit-identity of the BOS graph HC BF16: c94da765c4bbf795b598d96209cd80821e5a81ab97a8712586f54b8c8b612597. e2e asserts this. 0 fallbacks. greedy token=5.
candidates.alu_note: ALU idle 0.77%; occupancy is the remaining GPU lever at these bytes

candidates.name: C1_lossless_entropy_of_native_codes
candidates.mechanism: ANS/Huffman of already-quantized native codes. Does not drop levels. Reconstruction work is extra ALU; DSV4F can afford it (opposite of Q80).
candidates.numeric_contract: bit-identity PRESERVED: decoder reconstructs the exact native E2M1/E4M3/E8M0 codes before the existing matvec. hc_sha stays c94da765c4bbf795b598d96209cd80821e5a81ab97a8712586f54b8c8b612597.
candidates.alu_note: MORE reconstruction is affordable here because ALU is idle; bytes are the scarce resource

candidates.name: C2_mla_shared_fp8_to_fp4_lm_fp8
candidates.mechanism: Requantize still-wide classes onto the SAME native family DSV4F already executes: MLA+shared FP8 E4M3 → FP4 E2M1+UE8M0/32; lm_head BF16→FP8 E4M3+UE8M0/128; router BF16→FP8. Routed experts stay native 16-level FP4. Q80 mixed rates are not used.
candidates.numeric_contract: NEW hc_sha (bit-identity broken). Proposed quality bar: BOS greedy token-id unchanged; |logit-16.78185|<=0.05 (existing oracle slack); final-HC cosine vs sealed BF16 HC >= 0.995; max-abs on wq_a probe reported in this receipt. The e2e assert MUST be rewritten to the new sealed hash plus these numeric bounds — do not silently drop the assert.
candidates.hc_sha: MUST_RESEAL — any requant changes c94da765 by construction
candidates.alu_note: decode path already exists (FP4/FP8 kernels). Extra ALU vs current FP8 MLA is cheap; ALU is 0.77%.

candidates.name: C3_all_fp4_including_head
candidates.mechanism: C2 plus lm_head and router also to native FP4.
candidates.numeric_contract: NEW hc_sha. Same greedy-token + cosine>=0.99 + logit slack. LM head is currently 341 GB/s / 82.8% of ceiling — compressing it is the one organ where bytes map 1:1 onto GPU microseconds.
candidates.alu_note: lm_head is bandwidth-saturated already; FP4 decode tax is the Q80-opposite trade and is acceptable

candidates.name: C4_c2_plus_topk4
candidates.mechanism: C2 representation plus num_experts_per_tok 6→4 (source config is 6).
candidates.numeric_contract: NEW hc_sha AND a routing contract: top-4 of 256 instead of top-6. This is fewer ACTIVE weights, not a lower BPW. Quality must be re-proven on the fullseq capture set, not just BOS greedy.
candidates.hc_sha: MUST_RESEAL — routing change moves HC even with identical tensors
candidates.alu_note: fewer expert matvecs; occupancy-neutral; bytes drop linearly

candidates.name: C5_c3_plus_routed_3bit
candidates.mechanism: Drop routed experts from 16-level E2M1 to 8-level (3 BPW + 0.25 scale). This is a NEW codec on already-quantized data.
candidates.numeric_contract: NEW hc_sha. Second quantization of already 16-level expert codes down to 8 levels. Requires a measured expert-output cosine (propose >=0.99 vs native FP4) AND fullseq greedy-token match rate. Q80's 0.14-1.13 expert BPW does NOT apply — those started from BF16, not E2M1.
candidates.alu_note: cheaper decode than E2M1 (smaller LUT). Bytes, not ALU, are why you would do this.

candidates.name: C6_attention_2bpw_experts_2bpw
candidates.mechanism: Sub-native-FP4 on every class. Only path into the 3-4 GB band without cutting top-k. Reconstruction will be heavier than E2M1; DSV4F's idle ALU is the reason this is even discussable.
candidates.numeric_contract: NEW hc_sha. This is a research codec (structured residual / low-rank+codes on already-quantized native values), not a native-family requant. Propose: final-HC cosine >=0.98 and fullseq token match as the admission bar. Not bit-identical.
candidates.alu_note: Q80 could not afford this (reconstruction was the wall). DSV4F can, IF the codec actually cuts bytes.

candidates.name: C7_half_gb_fantasy
candidates.mechanism: The 0.5 GB figure that would make 20 ms possible at today's 6.3% of roof. Requires ~0.31 active BPW on 12.75B weights, or deleting ~95% of the forward. Not reachable on this model.
candidates.numeric_contract: not a serious contract — arithmetic only
candidates.alu_note: irrelevant; the weights would have to not exist

diagnosis_byte_budget.note: Unique stored bytes the GPU must read at least once per BOS token. Activations and scratch are extra and small. TOKEN_NS 5.857 GB used a 3.67 BPW blend and is not the stored traffic.

q80_rates_do_not_transfer.why: Q80's 0.14-1.13 expert organ rates measure redundancy in BF16. DSV4F experts are already 16 reconstruction levels. Applying those rates here is a unit error.

earlier_ledger_correction.what_the_earlier_ledger_got_right: MLA ~4.6, routed top-6 ~3.45, shared ~1.08. Those three are confirmed against sealed pair geometry AND against the 69,187-tensor manifest.
earlier_ledger_correction.what_it_missed: lm_head 1.059 GB BF16 and router 0.090 GB BF16. Together they are 1.149 GB (11.2%) of the 10.280. TOKEN_NS 5.857 GB at 3.676 BPW is a blend and under-counts stored traffic by 1.755x; DSV4F_GPU_BODY_DIAGNOSIS already rejected it.
earlier_ledger_correction.host_attn_io_was_4.667_gb: TOKEN_NS host.attn_weight_io_prefetch+io = 4,667,468,196. That is MLA 4,599,335,040 plus 68 MB of aux/upload padding, NOT the 801 MB indexer.

indexer_compressor.note: 41 of 43 layers (ratio-4 and ratio-128). L0/L1 sliding-window have none.

mhc_f32.why_excluded_from_dram_floor: The 10.280 / 411.51 floor is GPU-must-read unique weights. MHC is a 24x16384 F32 host transform.

norms_and_mla_aux.note: attn_sink + q_norm + kv_norm + RMSNorms. <1 MB. Irrelevant to the floor.

hash_tid2eid.note: I64 table, not a GEMV. ~19 MB.

embed_full_table.note: one BF16 row of 4096. Full table is storage, not active.

mtp.note: num_nextn_predict_layers=1 is not on the base 43-layer path

achievable_bpw.lossless_floor_is_not_q80: Routed FP4 codes measure 3.86-3.89 bits (all 16 levels used). MLA FP8 codes measure 6.54-6.61 bits (254/256 finite E4M3 codes used). BF16 head/router measure ~10.5 bits. This is DSV4F's own entropy, not Q80's 0.14-1.13 organ rates on BF16.

below_native_fp4.note: These are NEW codecs on already-quantized data. Q80 rates do not transfer.

verdict.how: C2: requant MLA+shared FP8→native FP4 and lm_head BF16→FP8. 7.042 GB. Floor 17.11 ms. roof_tok_s 58.44. First candidate that clears the 8.230 GB A-budget.

lossless_proof.statement: Measured Shannon of the native codes, plus the existing UE8M0 scales, plus 0.5% ANS overhead, is 8.839 GB (21.48 ms floor, 46.56 TPS roof). That is 0.608 GB ABOVE the 8.230 GB A-budget and 3.44 TPS short of 50. You cannot beat Shannon losslessly. Therefore no hc_sha-preserving representation change makes 20 ms possible on this artifact.

realistic_3_to_4_gb.requires: A research codec at ~2 active BPW on already-quantized native FP4/FP8, OR a deeper top-k cut plus C3. C4 (C2+top-4) is still 5.89 GB.
realistic_3_to_4_gb.numeric_contract: NEW hc_sha. Propose final-HC cosine >= 0.98 vs sealed BF16 HC and fullseq greedy-token match. Do not silently drop the e2e assert.

half_gb_at_today_occupancy.why: 0.5 GB on 12.749B active weights is 0.31 BPW, or deleting ~95% of the forward. C7 is arithmetic only. Occupancy work (~16x) is the right way to spend the 6.3%→roof gap; it cannot invent the missing 2.05 GB.

verdict.occupancy_is_still_required: Every candidate that makes 20 ms POSSIBLE still needs the occupancy lane to approach the floor. At today's 6.3% of roof, C2 is 273 ms. Bytes make the gate possible; occupancy makes it real. ALU is idle (0.77%), so reconstruction-heavier codecs are the right trade here — the opposite of Q80.
verdict.decode_token_caveat: BOS skips 801075968 bytes of indexer/compressor. A real pos>0 decode adds 0.801 GB. C0 decode floor becomes 26.93 ms. C2+indexer is 7.843 GB / 19.06 ms — still under 20 ms, still A-reachable.

hc_sha_policy.C0_and_C1: keep the assert; they are bit-identical (C1 reconstructs native codes)
hc_sha_policy.C2_and_beyond: MUST replace SEALED_GRAPH_HC_BF16_SHA256 with a newly sealed hash of the new graph AND keep a numeric bar (greedy token-id, logit slack 0.05, HC cosine). wq_a FP8→FP4 probe on captured L0 X: cosine=0.996532, rel_l2=0.0837. That is the starting evidence for a 0.995 cosine proposal on C2, not a seal.
